import json,sys;from pathlib import Path;from runner import checkpoints
w=Path(sys.argv[1]); cp=json.load(sys.stdin); p=w/'checkpoints'/f'{cp}.md'; raw,view=checkpoints.prepare(cp,p.read_bytes(),'approved','reviewed',decision_id='eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee',decided_at='now',source='cli');p.write_bytes(raw);print(json.dumps(view.to_dict()))

import json,sys;from pathlib import Path;from runner import coven,actions
w=Path(sys.argv[1]);b=json.load(sys.stdin);i=coven.runtime_launch_inputs(w);assert i==b['inputs'];assert coven.frozen_launch_plan(actions.ActionStore(w).read_control(),b['action_id'],i)==b['plan'];sys.stdout.buffer.write(actions.checkpoint_bytes(b))

import sys,json;from pathlib import Path;from runner import actions

import sys;from pathlib import Path;from runner import coven

import sys,json;from pathlib import Path;from runner import coven;print(json.dumps(coven.runtime_launch_inputs(Path(sys.argv[1]))))

import sys,json;from pathlib import Path;from runner import checkpoints
w=Path(sys.argv[1]);i=json.load(sys.stdin);cp='runtime-launch-'+i;p=w/'checkpoints'/f'{cp}.md';original=p.read_bytes();raw,view=checkpoints.prepare(cp,original.replace(b'unrestricted',b'read-only'),'approved','changed scope',decision_id='ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff',decided_at='now',source='cli');p.write_bytes(raw);print(json.dumps(view.to_dict()))

import sys,json;from pathlib import Path;from runner import actions,storage
w=Path(sys.argv[1]);r=json.load(sys.stdin);s=actions.ActionStore(w)
with storage.workspace_lock(w,w/'state/.workspace.lock') as lock:
 a=s.acknowledge_unknown(r['id'],r['claim'],lock);b,replayed=s.claim(r['id'],r['manifest'],r['checkpoint'],r['decision'],{},lock);assert a==b and replayed;print(json.dumps(a))
